result.title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
result.summary: Selecting intermediate features from a frozen diffusion model for discriminative tasks is non-trivial because the useful signal is distributed across the denoising trajectory, network depth, and channels. In practice, this requires choosing a timestep, a block, and a channel subset. Existing methods either fix these choices by hand or optimize only a few extraction hyperparameters, most often the timestep, then reuse the same rule across inputs and budgets. We introduce Policy-Mask, a budget-conditioned policy trained on the downstream objective that jointly selects all three under a prescribed channel budget. Without normalization, the channel-score contribution grows with the number of selected channels and dominates the timestep and block updates. We normalize it by subset cardinality, keeping the three policy heads on comparable scales and stabilizing joint training. At matched budgets, Policy-Mask improves over fixed extraction and feature-filter baselines across segmentation, classification, and semantic correspondence, reaching 38.9 mIoU on ADE20K, 75.4% top-1 on CIFAR-100 at 128 dimensions, and 76.3 PCK@0.1 on SPair-71k. Component-wise ablations show that block selection materially affects downstream accuracy, and the highest recorded channel-budget score occurs at 256 retained channels, identifying a practical operating point for compact diffusion representations. We further adapt Policy-Mask to diffusion transformers, including PixArt-$Σ$ and SD3.5 MMDiT, by replacing U-Net channels with image-token hidden dimensions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Policy-Mask，用下游目标训练一个受通道预算约束的策略，联合选择冻结扩散模型中用于判别任务的去噪时间步、网络块和通道子集，并通过对通道分数按子集大小归一化来稳定三头联合训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按预算动态选择哪些层/通道/时间步的特征」与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、计算预算分配和停止决策可能有概念联系，但面向判别任务的静态特征抽取而非推理状态生成，迁移价值需核查。
